## Returning Players

### What Changed in Patch 102

- Duranium, Scout, Azart, and Superior gear have been removed.
- Entropy/Ethereal/Radiant accessories, Luminous Essence, and Morphers have been removed.
- Uncommon Relics and Halidoms have been removed.
- Onset, Infinity, and Transcendent Masks have been removed.
- At level 65 in Highwatch, you now receive **Warlord accessories**, **Kaia's Fury/Wisdom gear**, and an **Exodor Mask**.
- You may upgrade Superior gear to Kaia without completing the story quest — it costs **100 Manaforce Ore** and **11,000 gold** per piece at Muhrak's Workshop.
- Gear progression has been made linear again (similar to Heroic Oath).
- **Best in Slot gear is now Kaia's Soul.**

### What Changed in Patch 103

- You can no longer **lose** an enchantment level when enchanting Kaia's Fury/Wisdom.

## Character Building & Stat Balancing

*Applies to all classes.*

### Understanding Your Stats

Stat balancing (min-maxing) is about getting the most value out of every stat point. Each stat's usefulness is influenced by how much of your other stats you already have. From most to least valuable for DPS:

**Crit → Amp → Power → Amp Crit Power**

- **Crit Factor** has a hard cut-off (your class's Crit-Cap). Skills have a max Crit-Rate and every enemy has CR — these together define your effective Crit-Cap. Note that dungeons newer than Akalath Quarantine introduced variable enemy CR.
- **Amplification** is the biggest DPS boost because unlike Power, you mostly don't need to balance it against other stats. The primary source is enchanting your gear.
- **Power** is the second biggest DPS boost but requires balancing against Crit. Main source is Power accessories. Start with Crit accessories, find your class Crit-Cap, calculate your excess Crit, and morph accessories to Power when the excess exceeds the accessory's Crit value.
- **Amp Crit Power** becomes relevant later, once your Amp reaches ~90k and Power reaches ~400. At that point, Amp Crit Power rolls on Weapon, Gloves, and Innerwear start to pull ahead.
- **Crit Power** (pre-Exodor) used to be the biggest DPS boost via weapon crystals. With Exodor gear those crystals are obsolete — don't prioritize Crit Power infusion rolls.

### Power ↔ Amp Conversion Reference

| 1 Power equals... | Your current Amp range |
| ----------------- | ---------------------- |
| 500 Amp           | 80k – 100k Amp         |
| 450 Amp           | 60k – 70k Amp          |
| 400 Amp           | 40k – 50k Amp          |
| 350 Amp           | 10k – 30k Amp          |
| 2 Crit            | —                      |

# Patch 91–102

## Weapon & Armor

### Upgrade Priority

Upgrade your gear slots in this order:

> **Weapon > Handwear > Body > Footwear**

- **Weapon** — largest source of Amp and all bonus roll types.
- **Handwear** — second largest source of Amp and DPS bonus rolls.
- **Body** — largest source of Resistance, second largest DEF bonus rolls.
- **Footwear** — same Amp as Body, fewest bonus rolls.

### Etching Suggestions

| Slot   | Etching                              | Benefit                |
| ------ | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------- |
| Body   | T3+ Grounded (8 END)                 | Increases effective HP |
| Feet   | T3+ Grounded (8 END)                 | Increases effective HP |
| Weapon | T3+ Energetic (2.5% CDR, 4% ATK SPD) | Smoother rotations     |
| Gloves | T3+ Energetic (2.5% CDR, 4% ATK SPD) | Smoother rotations     |

### Stat Infusion Priority

`4 Power > 7 Crit > 3 Power > 5 Crit > 2 Power ≥ 4 Crit > 0.02 Crit Power > 1 Power ≥ 2 Crit > 0.01 Crit Power`

### Gear Tier Reference

| Name                      | Physical / Magical    | Rarity   | Infusions | Equivalent Enchantment |
| ------------------------- | --------------------- | -------- | --------- | ---------------------- |
| Kaia's                    | Fury / Wisdom         | Mythic   | 3         | Best in Slot           |
| Annihilation / Dark Light | —                     | Superior | 2         | +10 = +6 Kaia          |
| Azart                     | Dauntless / Manaforce | Rare     | 1         | +10 = +6 Superior      |
| Scout                     | Maroon / Azure        | Rare     | 0         | +15 = +6 Superior      |
| Duranium                  | Master's / Flawless   | Uncommon | 0         | +10 = +6 Azart         |

### How to Acquire Mythic (Kaia's) Gear

![How to Acquire Mythic Gear — Kaia's Anvil UI and crafting instructions](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Talk to the NPC **Fovarth** at **Muhrak's Workshop in Habere** after completing the **Kaia's Anvil** quest. At the Kaia's Anvil UI:

- Place your **Annihilation** (Physical Amp) or **Dark Light** (Magical Amp) Exodor gear as the Enhancement Item.
- Place a **Black Core Essence** (or Heroic Oath gear) as the Core Item.
- Both items are consumed on a successful craft.

**Using Heroic Oath gear as the Core Item** carries over your enchantment levels and reduces material costs significantly. **Black Core Essence** can substitute for any Core Item — Fovarth exchanges **Black Core Nodules** (from Corrupted Skynest) for Black Core Essences at a **10:1 ratio**.

### Mythic Gear Material Costs

![Mythic Gear Material Costs — promotion tables for weapon, armor, gloves/boots](data:image/webp;base64,)

Material costs vary based on the gear slot and how enchanted your Heroic Oath piece is. Higher enchantment levels on your core item reduce material requirements substantially. See the table above for exact costs by slot (Weapon / Armor / Gloves & Boots) at each Heroic Oath enchantment level (+0 through +3) versus using Dark Magic Essence.

**Mythic gear also gains the following unique properties:**

- Increases Magical/Physical Amplification and Resistance.
- Applies the **Kaia's Judgement** passive: on attack, chance to reduce the target's Critical Resistance by 25 and Physical/Magical Resistance by 2,000. *(Does not stack with Azart Mark.)*
- Applies a **weapon type-specific skill** based on your class:

| Weapon Type                                                                 | Skill            | Effect                                                                                   |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Lance                                                                       | Kaia's Will      | +5% damage to enraged monsters; +50% aggro from enraged monsters                         |
| Powerfist                                                                   | Kaia's Will      | +5% damage to enraged monsters; +50% aggro from enraged monsters (Growing Fury excluded) |
| Twin Swords, Greatsword, Axe, Disc, Bow, Scythe, Arcannon, Shuriken, Glaive | Kaia's Challenge | +5% damage when above 80% HP                                                             |
| Staff, Scepter                                                              | Kaia's Shield    | +5% damage to enraged monsters; +20% healing to targets below 40% HP                     |

## Mask

Aim at minimum for an **Energetic Transcendent Mask** — the 3.4% CDR enables smoother rotations. Exodor masks are generally better than most Bahaar masks because they always provide 3.4% CDR and 3,300 Amp by default. However, a Bahaar mask with ideal random rolls can theoretically be best-in-slot.

**Tier:** Bahaar ≥ Exodor > Transcendent > Infinity > Onset

**Type:** Energetic (CDR) > Powerful (Power) > Keen (Crit) > Bitter (Crit Power)

| Tier         | Energetic | Powerful | Keen    | Bitter          | Additional                            |
| ------------ | --------- | -------- | ------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Onset        | 2.4% CDR  | 4 Power  | 8 Crit  | 0.04 Crit Power | 2 Endurance                           |
| Infinity     | 3.0% CDR  | 6 Power  | 12 Crit | 0.06 Crit Power | 3 Endurance                           |
| Transcendent | 3.4% CDR  | 8 Power  | 16 Crit | 0.08 Crit Power | 4 Endurance                           |
| Bahaar       | 3.4% CDR  | 8 Power  | 16 Crit | 0.08 Crit Power | 1–3 random rolls                      |
| Exodor       | —         | —        | —       | —               | 3.4% CDR, 3,300 Amp, 1–3 random rolls |

## Accessories

### Priority Order

Power accessories are more valuable than Crit accessories for Rings, Earrings, and Necklaces because they break the standard 2:1 Crit:Power ratio in Power's favor. Earrings outprioritize Necklace because their combined value is greater.

> **Rings > Earrings > Necklace**

**Type priority:** Warlord > Radiant > Ethereal > Entropy

### Etching Priority

| Tier | Pumped (Power)     | Keen (Crit)       |
| ---- | ------------------ | ----------------- |
| I    | 1 Power            | 2 Crit            |
| II   | 2 Power            | 4 Crit            |
| III  | 2 Power + 1,500 HP | 4 Crit + 1,500 HP |
| IV   | 3 Power + 1,500 HP | 6 Crit + 1,500 HP |

### Roll Priority by Slot

| Slot     | Priority                                            |
| -------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| Circlet  | 8 Crit ≥ 4 Power > 4 Endurance                      |
| Rings    | 4 Power > 4 Crit ≥ 2 Power > 2 Crit > 4 END > 2 END |
| Necklace | 4 Power > 4 Crit > 4 Endurance                      |
| Earrings | 4% HP > 4 END > 2% HP > 2 END > 10% Decrease Stun   |

### Recommended Rolls

| Slot     | Target Roll         |
| -------- | ------------------- |
| Circlet  | 8 Crit              |
| Necklace | 4 Power             |
| Earrings | 4 Endurance & 4% HP |
| Rings    | 4 Crit & 4 Power    |
| Brooch   | 6 Crit & 3 Power    |
| Belt     | 6 Crit & 3 Power    |

## Relics & Halidoms

## Advance Skills

Advance Skills are the last priority due to their high cost to fully max out. That said, putting **one level** into your level 66, 68, and 70 Advance Skills is an immediate, cheap stat boost and should be done early.

### How to Level Advance Skills

There are three methods:

1. Gold + Advance Skill Scrolls
2. Rare Magic Advance Skill Tome + Advance Skill Scrolls
3. Superior Magic Advance Skill Tome (event-only so far)

### Priority

- If your class has two Power Advance Skills, level the **level 66** one first — it's cheaper.
- Classes with a Crit-Cap over 200: level your **Crit** Advance Skill first.
- Classes with a Crit-Cap under 200: level your **Power** Advance Skill first.

> **Order:** Power (max 20) ≥ Crit (max 40) > Endurance (max 40)

### Full Cost Breakdown

| Advance Skill | Total Gold    | Total Scrolls |
| ------------- | ------------- | ------------- |
| Level 66      | 244,860 G     | 2,141 T1 Adv. |
| Level 67      | 75,000 G      | 720 T1 Opt.   |
| Level 68      | 265,660 G     | 3,483 T2 Adv. |
| Level 69      | 97,500 G      | 900 T2 Opt.   |
| Level 70      | 288,240 G     | 4,701 T3 Adv. |
| **Total**     | **971,260 G** | —             |

> **Note:** As of Patch 99, Advance Skill gold costs have been halved.

## Patch 91–102 FAQ

**How much Power should I have?**
There is no Power cap unlike Crit. Aim for 300+ Power — you won't reach that easily without stat balancing.

**How much Amplification should I have?**
Amplification is largely outside your direct control. The vast majority will come from enchanting your gear.

**I see gear with Amplification rolls — should I get that?**
Amplification isn't the best roll for most classes. Check the class table and your class discord for specific recommendations.

**The suggested rolls gave me too much Crit — what should I do?**
Without going below your Crit-Cap, morph an accessory to Power or replace Crit rolls with a priority Power roll.

**How do I reroll accessory stats?**
Patch 97 made Semi-Enigmatic Scrolls unusable. In short, you don't anymore.

**How do I morph accessories?**
Magic Material merchants in Highwatch, Velika, and Kaiator sell **Uncommon Accessory Morphers** for 10,000 gold.

**Where do I get upgrade materials for Radiant Accessories?**
All dungeons above RK9 drop **Luminous Mana Essence**, which can be exchanged for the required materials.

**Where do I get etchings?**
Crafting, the Trade Broker, or Vanguard Requests (IoD BAMs). Note: as of Patch 97, World Bosses no longer drop etchings.

**Where do I get blue Relics & Halidoms?**
Intel Reports, Naslow Maps, Caiman Portals, Pet Adventures, Velik's Dream (Story Quest), and Akalath Quarantine (dungeon).

**Where do I get Innerwear?**
Ghiliglade (Goldfinger Tokens), the Tera Store, or the Trade Broker.

**How do I use [item]?**
Try right-clicking it.

# Patch 103–113

## Weapon & Armor

### Upgrade Priority

> **Weapon > Handwear > Body > Footwear**

Same reasoning as Patch 91–102 above.

### Etching Suggestions

| Slot   | Etching                              | Benefit                |
| ------ | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------- |
| Body   | T3+ Grounded (8 END)                 | Increases effective HP |
| Feet   | T3+ Grounded (8 END)                 | Increases effective HP |
| Weapon | T3+ Energetic (2.5% CDR, 4% ATK SPD) | Smoother rotations     |
| Gloves | T3+ Energetic (2.5% CDR, 4% ATK SPD) | Smoother rotations     |

### Bonus Rolls

- Starting Kaia's Fury/Wisdom gear has **no bonus rolls**.
- You can buy Kaia's Fury/Wisdom gear **with bonus rolls** on the Trade Broker, or earn them from dungeons.
- When upgrading Kaia's Fury/Wisdom → Kaia's Soul, **bonus rolls are wiped**.
- You can restore rolls on Kaia's Soul using **Option Change Scrolls** obtained from dungeon Clan Rewards.

Refer to the class table above for your class's ideal bonus rolls.

### Infusion Priority

`4 Power > 7 Crit > 3 Power > 5 Crit > 2 Power ≥ 4 Crit > 0.02 Crit Power > 1 Power ≥ 2 Crit > 0.01 Crit Power`

## Accessories

### How to Acquire

- You receive a set of **Federation Supply: Warlord** accessories at level 65 in Highwatch.
- Run **DAN** for Non-Federation Warlord Rings and Necklaces.
- Run **CSN** for Non-Federation Warlord Circlets.
- All Non-Federation accessories can also be purchased on the Trade Broker.

### Bonus Rolls

Federation accessories **cannot** have bonus rolls added. To add bonus rolls you need Non-Federation accessories and/or Option Change Scrolls.

### Priority

> **Rings > Earrings > Necklace**

Power accessories are more valuable (same reasoning as Patch 91–102).

---

## Relics & Halidoms

### How to Acquire

Relics and Halidoms drop from Intel Reports, Naslow Maps, Caiman Portals, Pet Adventures, **Velik's Dream** and **Devastated Villagers** (Story Quests), and dungeons.

### Upgrading

Upgrading is done through the **Forging UI**. Each tier requires a Relic or Halidom of the same tier plus gold. Success rates are hidden.

> **Tip:** Gameforge holds an upgrade event at the end of each month with approximately 50–90% success rates depending on tier — a great time to push upgrades.

### Priority

- DPS/non-hybrid healers: use **Blue (Rare) Crit** Relics & Halidoms.
- Classes with Crit-Cap 200+: ideally use **Superior** Relics.
- Classes with Crit-Cap below 200: use a **Blue (Rare) Power** Relic/Halidom.
- Minimum target: **T2 Rare Relic & Halidom**.

## Advance Skills

### How to Acquire Skill XP

- Ace, One-Star, and Two-Star dungeons grant one **Skill Advancement Tome (Medium)**.
- Three-Star and higher dungeons grant one **Skill Advancement Tome (Extra-Large)**.
- Daily Vanguard Quests in Exodor award **125k Skill XP**.

### How to Acquire Scrolls & Tomes

- Celestial Arena, Ace dungeons, and regular dungeons give random amounts of Skill Scrolls.
- Serghetto Boxes from Development Merchants provide Tomes.
- There are three advancement methods:
  1. Gold + Skill Advancement Scrolls
  2. Skill Advancement Book + Skill Advancement Scrolls
  3. Complete Skill Advancement Book *(event-only so far)*

### Priority

- Put **one level** into each Advance Skill immediately for a cheap stat boost.
- If your class has two Power Advance Skills, level the **level 66** one first.
- Crit-Cap 200+: level **Crit** first. Below 200: level **Power** first.

> **Order:** Power (max 20) ≥ Crit (max 40) > Endurance (max 40)

### Full Cost Breakdown

| Level 68      | 265,660 G     | 3,483 T2 Adv. |
| Level 69      | 97,500 G      | 900 T2 Opt.   |
| Level 70      | 288,240 G     | 4,701 T3 Adv. |

## Patch 103–113 FAQ

**How much Power should I have?**
There is no Power cap. Aim for 300+ Power through stat balancing.

**How much Amplification should I have?**
Amplification is mostly outside your control — the majority comes from enchanting gear.

**I got gear with bonus rolls — should I use it?**
Only if you haven't already upgraded the piece it would replace.

**I have too much Crit — what should I do?**
Without going below your Crit-Cap, swap sources of Crit for Power based on your gear priorities.

**Where do I get etchings?**
Crafting, the Trade Broker, or Vanguard Requests (IoD BAMs). World Bosses no longer drop etchings as of Patch 97.

**How do I use [item]?**
Try right-clicking it.
